task.description:
Implement the APPROVED design at src/design/iss0630-migration-scope-qualification-fix.md (PASSed CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR). Fixes ISS-0630/GH-605 (BLOCKER): 9 migration files declare '-- scope: public' but contain unqualified table statements, breaking fresh-database bootstrap.

1. Edit all 9 files in place, qualifying every CREATE TABLE / ALTER TABLE / DROP TABLE / INSERT INTO statement the design identifies with public. -- do NOT add a corrective/backfill migration, these are edit-in-place fixes to already-idempotent statements:
   - migrations/011_webhook_subscriptions.sql
   - migrations/022_obs06_alerting_state.sql
   - migrations/038_oidc_claim_mapping_config.sql
   - migrations/039_jit_provisioning_config.sql
   - migrations/041_oidc15_realm_deletion_tracker.sql
   - migrations/042_oidc16_26_agent_lifecycle_foundations.sql
   - migrations/049_repository_service_catalog.sql
   - migrations/056_onboarding_registry.sql

2. Add the new fresh_database_migration CI job to .github/workflows/ci.yml per the design (Postgres 15 service container, zig build migrate against a genuinely empty database, judged by exit code only).

VALIDATION -- this is the load-bearing check: create a genuinely fresh, empty PostgreSQL database (docker exec into the db_test container, CREATE DATABASE) and run zig build migrate against it end-to-end. It must exit 0 and apply ALL migration files including past 011, 022, 038, 039, 041, 042, 049, 056, 094 without any scope-mismatch error. Do this for real -- ORCH already reproduced the failure this way and will independently re-verify your fix the same way.

Also confirm this workspace's own long-lived db_test database (BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5453/bpm_test) still migrates cleanly after your edits (these files are already ledger-recorded there, so your edits should be no-ops on that database -- confirm zig build migrate against it still exits 0 with no new migrations applied, proving the edits didn't regress the already-applied-elsewhere case).
acceptance_criteria: All 9 files edited in place with public.-qualification, no backfill migration

zig build migrate against a genuinely fresh, empty database exits 0, applies all files
